answer: Charge every new identity a 100-unit stake into a shared oasis pool before it may draw nectar: the first clone costs 100, the second 200, the third 400, so N clones cost 100 x (2^N - 1). A hollow identity with no work history must lock its stake for 30 days instead of 7, so each extra clone idles longer while the bill doubles. Sybils pay exponentially and wait longest.
